Lena: Quick ask-the-room: what's one weird or sentimental thing on your desk right now and the short story behind it? non-work, pls.
Omar: a tiny ceramic avocado someone gave me on my first week. it's chipped now, but it survived three moves so it's staying. :avocado:
Vik: rubber duck. i use it to rubber-duck debug and it has a tiny cape.
Hana: a postcard from my grandparom 1998. he wrote a short joke on the back. makes meetings less bleak.
Lena: @Vik superhero duck = excellent. any pics?
Vik: posted: https://imgur.com/example-duck (not actually vintage, but close)
Omar: @Hana that postcard thing is wholesome. mine's the avocado but i also have a concert wristband from 2014 taped to a monitor. memory lane.
Hana: @Omar concert wristband = instant mood boost. which show?
Omar: Arcade Fire. loud and life-changing.
kudos-bot: triggered: sent a kudos to Omar for bringing culture to the desk.
Lena: my odd item is a tiny hourglass i flip for 5-min focus sprints. accidentally started timing lunch once and nearly missed a meeting. :sweat_smile:
Vik: this thread is a great reason to tidy up. i'm finding sticky notes that are older than some teammates.
Hana: pledge: i'll bring a weird item to the next optional video hangout and explain the origin story.
Lena: love that. optional show-and-tell next Friday 3pm? small, silly, zero agenda.
Omar: i'm in. will also bring a backup avocado in case mine's hungry. :laughing:
Vik: backup duck is a wise move.
Lena: thanks all, brightened my afternoon. feel free to keep dropping pics/mini-stories here.
